title: Invoice Review and Actions — Fusion ERP
summary: Review supplier invoices and prepare or execute explicitly requested invoice creation, cancellation, or line cancellation through the configured Fusion REST sources. Shows the exact target and proposed values before requesting confirmation. Draft: source authentication and action behavior require target-environment validation.

platform.product: Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory

connectionContext: Existing Fusion invoice read and action sources; endpoint and credentials remain environment-local.

memory.description: No persistent memories or cross-thread context.

capabilities: Invoice reads, creation, cancellation and line cancellation through separate read/action REST sources.
Exact-target confirmation, no automatic retry of ambiguous writes, and API-result-based outcome reporting.
prerequisites: PAF 26.7-compatible visual Agent Builder and a registered model.
Confirmed Fusion demo endpoint and a suitably scoped integration account.

tools.name: Cancel line
tools.purpose: Cancel the specifically confirmed invoice line.

safetyControls: The flow can change Fusion invoices. It is an unpublished draft; no transaction was executed during migration.
Conversational confirmation is an instruction, not a server-enforced approval mechanism. Restrict integration-account permissions and add an external approval gateway before unattended use.
Do not retry an ambiguous write automatically. Do not claim payment, posting or approval capabilities.
setup: Import the release .paf into an unpublished destination flow.

Import assets/invoice-read-openapi.json and assets/invoice-actions-openapi.json as separate REST sources. Replace the example server URL with your confirmed Fusion endpoint and configure authentication in PAF. These reconstructed contracts require target-release validation.

Select AIW26-PAF-HOL6004-BOO6096 on every Agent node. This OpenAI Compatible connection is configured on build.oracleagentfactory.com and is the required model for the final AI World lab instances. Configure that same model name in each destination; model definitions and credentials are not bundled.
Create or select the sources listed in assets/source-bindings.json; replace every environment-local node binding.
Check permissions and connectivity against the intended demo environment before publishing.

Read the numbered sticky notes from left to right. Agent Description provides workflow details and sample questions; use its expand control to read the full guide. The 2026-10-18 layout/model update preserves the workflow wiring and documented memory mode; the earlier validation record describes the original demo runs.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: List up to five supplier invoices and explain which fields need review. Do not change anything.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Prepare the exact proposal for an invoice change I specify. Show the target and required fields; do not execute it.

expectedOutcomes: Evidence is distinguished from assumptions and unavailable data.
Writes require a specific user-confirmed proposal; drafts are not reported as executed.

validation.status: Write validation blocked: confirmed create reported HTTP 403; cancellation tests pending
notes: Build ownership and AIW26-PAF-HOL6004-BOO6096 binding verified as editor@oracleagentfactory.com. Publication and memory settings preserved; the flow remains an unpublished draft.

Both REST nodes use authenticated editor-owned sources with compatible tool names. The earlier official export and rendered layout checks remain valid; this test changed no workflow or source configuration.
On 2026-10-18, a unique USD 0.02 invoice proposal displayed all required values and requested confirmation. An independent exact-number Fusion GET found zero matches before confirmation.

After explicit confirmation in the same chat, the agent reported HTTP 403 Forbidden from invoice creation and returned no InvoiceId. A separate exact-number Fusion GET again returned zero matches. The agent reported one attempt without retry; the test did not independently capture a raw tool trace, so execution count is not asserted.

No successful Fusion mutation was established and no cleanup invoice exists. Invoice cancellation and line cancellation remain untested because creation of their isolated fixture was blocked. Existing invoices were not selected as cancellation targets.

An administrator must review the integration account's invoice-write privileges and business-unit data access before continuing. Reconcile the unique test invoice number before any new attempt, then test create, line cancellation and whole-invoice cancellation on isolated fixtures. Read access does not establish write access.
